row.name: Mesa Laboratories Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 5 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.66 base_volume_vs_leg=0.77 base_volume_vs_avg=0.87
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 4.4% vs its 20-SMA, 5.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y criterion is a hard fail — the checklist records four prior breakouts since the move started, making today breakout five of a mature trend, which is exactly the 'third-day buyer becomes the bag holder' scenario at a larger scale. The burst bar also fails RE (range only 83% of the prior 5-bar max) and VOL (volume below the prior session), so the expansion that defines a momentum burst is absent on both measures. The base box visible in the chart is tight enough, but it sits atop a long extended run with the 20-day average already 4–6% below price, leaving little room for the setup to breathe.
claude.key_risk: This is breakout number 5 of a 42-session, 40% move; prior breakouts worked only 2 of 4, and the base sits at the top of a multi-month run with no fresh highs to chase.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the entry ceiling or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest and price drifts back toward the base high around 127.

row.summary: MLAB: +4.2% on 0.8× volume out of a base 10.3% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
